policy_metadata.validation_protocol: Multi-Origin Chronological Walk-Forward (4 Origins, 6 Steps Ahead, 240 Evaluation Points)
policy_metadata.untouched_test_period: May 2024 to December 2025 (20 Months Strictly Preserved)

hurdle_prediction_strategy.rationale: Expected-count yields lowest linear MAE (2.370) and highest Outbreak Recall (86.2%) and F1 (0.774). Thresholded tau=0.4 is optimal for suppressing false alarms to 15.4%.

missingness_weighting.rationale: Downweighting gap-imputed records prevents classifier probability collapse without breaking continuous lag features.

selection_criteria: Strict chronological out-of-sample validation evidence only (zero test data inspection)
Multi-origin temporal consistency across 4 origins (mean RMSE, std dev of RMSE across origins)
Epidemiological objective balance (count RMSE/MAE vs. outbreak detection F1)
Parsimony principle: prefer simpler or more stable model when performance is within 5% error margin

alternaria_solani.rationale: Lowest mean RMSE and MAE across all 4 origins; exceptional temporal consistency (std 0.150); recurrent hidden memory captures multi-month spore incubation cycles.

bipolaris_oryzae.rationale: Lowest mean RMSE across origins; lowest cross-origin variance among competitive models; effectively pools weather-disease correlations across all 10 Indian pathogens.

fusarium_oxysporum.rationale: Selected under stability and parsimony policy: achieves nearly 2x lower variance across origins (std 0.771 vs Local XGBoost std 1.480) with near-equivalent RMSE and superior Outbreak F1 (0.980 vs 0.960).

macrophomina_phaseolina.rationale: Rank 1 in count accuracy (RMSE 1.684, MAE 1.294) and Rank 1 in outbreak detection (100% recall, F1 0.800); recurrent reset gating models soil water deficit transitions accurately.

phytophthora_infestans.rationale: Lowest mean RMSE (2.347) and MAE (1.102); selected over complex neural architectures due to parsimony and lower inference overhead.

puccinia_striiformis.rationale: Extreme biological sparsity: 23 out of 24 validation months were zero; the single positive occurrence (May 2023 = 1.0) was an exact match with May 2022 (y_{t-12} = 1.0). Zero-parameter persistence eliminates any danger of overfitting to dormancy.

pyricularia_oryzae.rationale: Rank 1 in stability (std 1.278) with elite count accuracy (RMSE 1.414); avoids trajectory divergence during sudden monsoon-driven spore spikes.

ralstonia_solanacearum.rationale: Critical outbreak detection capability: captures 90.9% of active outbreak months (Recall 0.909, F1 0.741) on this highly severe bacterial pathogen where uncaptured outbreaks cause catastrophic crop loss.

rhizoctonia_solani.rationale: Rank 1 in count accuracy (RMSE 3.222, MAE 2.358) and Rank 1 in outbreak detection (Recall 0.950, F1 0.905); separates seasonal sheath dormancy from virulent monsoon outbreaks.

xanthomonas_oryzae.rationale: Parsimonious moving-average model outperforms complex ML (Global models overfit on this sparse, low-count series with max count 1.0, achieving RMSE 0.574 vs MA(1) 0.428).
